name: Margaret
bioAdditions: Youngs Family (1907) prints the will of 'Margaret Youngs late wife of Christopher Youngs deceased of Southwold', dated 27 Oct 1630, proved 8 Jan 1630/1 (Arch. Suff. Ipswich), dividing her household stuff among her six children John, Joseph, Christopher, Mary, Margaret and Martha, with sons John and Joseph as executors. She was buried at Southwold on 5 Nov 1630 (S1). Not ancestral on present evidence.

sources.citation: Selah Youngs Jr., Youngs Family: Vicar Christopher Yonges, his ancestors in England and his descendants in America (1907), pp. 38-41 (First and Second Generations)
